title: Subclass closure — RDFS9 transitive subClassOf
description: If A ⊑ B and B ⊑ C, the reasoner derives A ⊑ C. The default KB has a chain Father ⊑ Parent ⊑ Person; you should see Father ⊑ Person highlighted as an inferred subclass. Add another link (e.g. GrandFather ⊑ Father) to see the chain extend automatically.
